questions.question: Which of the following is the correct full form of CACP?

options.text: Chamber of Agro Chemicals and Pesticides
Centre for Agricultural Commission and Prices
Commission for Agricultural Costs and Prices
Centre for Agricultural costs and Policies

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **__Commission for Agricultural Costs and Prices__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **CACP **stands for Commission for Agricultural Costs and Prices.
 
• It is a statutory body formed under** Agriculture Price Commission Act, 1962**.
 
• It is an attached office of the **Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India, which came into existence in January 1965.​**
 
• It comprises **a body of 5 people a Chairman, Member Secretary, one Member (Official), and two Members (Non-Official).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

**Roles and Responsibilities of CACP**

 
• It provides an assurance of a stable price environment to the farmers.
 
• It helps them to obtain a f**air price for their crops, even in the unstable market situation**, hence preventing them from falling into the vicious cycle of debt. 
 
• The Government sets the** MSPs** on the basis of the recommendations given by this committee.
 
• The CACP recommends the MSPs for** 23 commodities, which include seven grains, five pulses, seven oilseeds, and four commercial crops.**

questions.question: When is the Martyr's Day observed in India every year?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **__30 January__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Martyrs' Day is observed on **30th January to mark the death anniversary of Mohandas Karamchand Gandhi, popularly known as Mahatma Gandhi ji**.
 
• It also marks the assassination of Mahatma Gandhi in **1948 by Nathuram Godse**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• Martyrs' Day, also known as Sarvodaya Day, is celebrated on various days like 30 January, 23 March, 19 May, 21 October, 17 November, and 19th November to honor the people who have sacrificed their lives for the nation.
 
• January 30 is observed as Martyrs Day nationally. On this day in 1948, Gandhiji was assassinated by Nathuram Godse. 23 March is the death anniversary of Bhagat, Sukhdev, and Rajguru, 19 May is celebrated as 'Language Martyrs Day', 21 October is celebrated as 'Police Martyrs' Day' (Police Commemoration Day),17 November is the death anniversary of Lal Lajpat Rai, and 19 November is the birthday of Rani Lakshmibai.

questions.question: Which of the following countries has been chosen as the co-chair of the International Union for Conservation of Nature (IUCN) - supported Asia Protected Areas Partnership (APAP) for a period of three years till November 2023?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **__India__.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• India will be the co-chair of the IUCN-supported Asia Protected Areas Partnership (APAP) for three years, after successfully increasing the population of tigers, lions, and leopards by protecting their habitats.
 
• In this capacity, it will assist other Asian countries in managing their protected areas.
 
• The APAP is a regional platform to help governments and other stakeholders to collaborate for more effective management of protected areas (PA) in the region.
 
 
• The APAP currently consists of 21 members from 17 countries.
 
• The APAP, formally launched at the IUCN World Parks Congress in Australia in 2014, is chaired by IUCN Asia and co-chaired by an APAP country member.
 
 
 
• There are now more than 10,900 protected areas in Asia.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• IUCN (International Union for Conservation of Nature) works to help build healthy protected area systems across the region as a foundation for nature and human well-being by strengthening the capacity for protected area establishment and management.

 
 
• Their work includes leading the creation of the Asia Protected Areas Partnership (APAP) which provides a regional platform for promoting and sharing best practices in protected area management and piloting IUCN’s Green List of Protected Areas.
 
• The current Director-General of IUCN: Bruno Oberle (Nov 2021)
 
• 5 October 1948, Fontainebleau, France foundation of IUCN.
 
• Headquarter: Switzerland

questions.question: When was the State Reorganisation Act passed by the Government of India?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **__1956.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The State Reorganization Act was passed by the Government of India in **1956**.
 
• It reformed the boundaries of Indian states and territories, systematizing them on a **language base**. 
 
• These provisions come under** Part I of the Constitution of India, Article 3.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• THE STATES REORGANISATION ACT, 1956:

 
 
• The reorganization of the states was demanded many times after independence.
 
• There were financial, economic and administrative, and regional language issues.
 
• In this context, the States Reorganisation Commission (SRC) was constituted in 1953.
 
• The Commission submitted its report in September 1955.
 
 
 
• The Commission was appointed by Prime Minister Jawahar Lal Nehru.
 
• SRC was headed by S. Fazal Ali and had two members namely M. Panikkar & H. N. Kunzru.

questions.question: Shaikh Muinuddin Sijzi (Moinuddin Chishti) dargah is situated in which of the following cities.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Ajmer**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ajmer Sharif Dargah/ Ajmer Dargah/Ajmer Sharif/Dargah Sharif is a Sufi tomb of the revered Sufi saint; Moinuddin Chishti.**
 
• It is located at** Ajmer** comprised of Chishti's grave.
 
• **Chishti** was a **charismatic and compassionate spiritual preacher and teacher.**
 
• The biographical accounts of his life written after his death report that he received the gifts of many "spiritual marvels (karāmāt), such as miraculous travel, clairvoyance, and visions of angels" in these years of his life.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

**Other important sufi saints:**

 
• Khwaja Moinuddin Chisti

 
 
• Khwaja Moinuddin Chisti also popularly known as Khwaja Gareeb Nawaz was a beloved Sufi saint of the Chisti order.
 
• He is known to be the direct descendant of Prophet Muhammad.
 
• Born in Sistan (present-day Eastern Iran and Southern Afghanistan, he travelled from Sistan to Lahore to Delhi, and finally settled in Ajmer, Rajasthan.
 
• His tomb in Ajmer, the Ajmer Sharif Dargah, is one of the holiest Islamic sites in the world.
 
• Muslims from across the world visit Dargah Sharif every year to offer their prayers.
 
• Not only Muslims but people belonging to different religions visit this shrine throughout the year.
 
 
 
• Baba Farid
 
 
• Baba Sheikh Farid as he is called all over Punjab, India, and Pakistan was born at the time when Punjab was going through great crossroads.
 
• Timur the Lame, Halaku (Son of Changez Khan), etc ravaged Punjab about 100 to 200 years before he was born.
 
• The Slave dynasty of Qutub-Ud-Din aibak was at that time being ruled by Sultan Balban. 200-300 years earlier to the West of India, the sword of Islam had swept in the countries like Iran, Afghanistan, and Eastern Europe.
 
• In India too, Slave Qutubdin Aibak tried to subdue people through force, but could only create a rift between different communities.
 
• Then came the Sufi saints from Arabia and other places to spread their message of love for Allah.
 
• Sufi saints like Khwaja Qutub-Ul-Din Bakhtiar Kaki, who was a Sayid of the Jafiri Hussaini tribe, were very famous.
 
 
 
• Qutubuddin Bakhtiyar Kaki
 
 
• Hazrat Khawaja Bakhtiyar Kaaki‎ was one and a half years old when his father passed away.
 
• Khawaja Qutubuddeen Bakhtiyar Kaaki‎ learned 15 chapters of the Holy Quran from his mother and his mother arranged for his further education and training.

questions.question: Which part of the human body has the growth stages divided into - Anagen, Catagen and Telogen?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **__Hair__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The human body's hair follicles comprise three distinctive phases: **anagen, catagen, and telogen phase**.
 
• **Anagen** is the growth phase and approximately 85% of all hairs are in a growing phase at any one time.
 
• **Melanin** is made in the hair bulb throughout this phase. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] ** Additional Information__**
 
• The** catagen** phase follows the anagen stage it is a **1- to 2-week transition stage between anagen and telogen**.
 
• **The telogen phase **is referred to as the resting phase which typically lasts for 3 months.

questions.question: LCD is a basic type of monitor. What is the full form of LCD?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __Liquid Crystal Display__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• LCD is a flat panel display system that is primarily seen in Computer screens, Televisions, and Cell Phones.
 
• It utilizes liquid crystals as its primary mode of operation instead of cathode rays.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Construction of LCD​

 
• It is comprised of two phases; the liquid and the solid matter with additional two layers comprised of two polarized filters & electrodes.
 
• This screen works by blocking the light beam also the solid element is the crystal and the combination of solid and liquid makes the image clear.

Advantages of LCD

 
• It has low cost and energy consumption with high energy efficiency.
 
• It is smaller, thinner, and is very flexible.
 
• It offers excellent contrast, brightness & resolution, so the accuracy of the image is as evident as crystal.
